note: WHERE THE DOCSTRING GOES, and where Emacs' own arity stops. Emacs answers ("Docs." (defalias 4)): the third argument lands on the symbol's `function-documentation' property -- so a docstring-taking `defalias' is a `put', not a wrapper object -- and a FOURTH argument is `wrong-number-of-arguments (defalias 4)'. That second half is the fence an implementation must keep: 2 or 3, never more. kg raises `wrong-number-of-arguments' on the first form of the pair at this pin, so the case cannot reach the arity it is here to pin.
